[RDSC.5a.5.4] `window_ns` is required (`> 0`) — the `SeriesBackendRingBuffer`
backend is only selected for `sliding <dur>` triples per
[RDSC.5a.2]. `max_samples` carries the series' `capacity`
([LSER.13.14]); `0` means the series declares none and the
window is the only bound. A non-zero `max_samples` caps the
samples each identity retains, even within the window, and a
sample arriving at the cap is dropped or refused as
[LSER.13.14] states for the backing's aggregation.
